title: Expected value of a random linear-constraint assignment
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and consider a nonempty instance of linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$, with every variable occurring in some equation. Each equation involves a positive number of pairwise distinct variables and has a right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$. Under an independent uniform assignment of values in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to the variables, the expected fraction of satisfied equations, counting multiplicities, is $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: every variable occurs in the scope of some constraint
each constraint has arity between $1$ and $r$ inclusive
each constraint uses pairwise distinct variables
the assignment is independently and uniformly sampled over $\mathbb{F}_2$
